sources_note: 來源與日期逐篇列明。公司公告按原文歸因，開放範圍以可核對的資料為準。
sources_note_en: Each story lists its source and date. Company announcements are attributed and availability follows the documented scope.
thesis: 購物入口擴展，品牌要分清商品導流、內容互動與成交
thesis_en: As shopping entry points expand, track product referrals, engagement and orders separately
thesis_note: 10篇已覆核新聞，涵蓋東南亞社交電商、商品目錄、受眾規劃、電郵製作及品牌活動。
thesis_note_en: 10 reviewed stories covering Southeast Asian social commerce, catalog feeds, audience planning, email production and brand events.

items.title: TikTok Shop獨立App登陸東南亞四個市場
items.title_en: Standalone TikTok Shop app reaches four Southeast Asian markets
items.summary: 據TechCrunch報道，獨立購物App已在新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國和菲律賓提供iOS及Android版本。
items.summary_en: TechCrunch reports iOS and Android availability in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines.
highlights: 用戶仍可透過直播及短片發掘商品。
報道列出的功能包括App內結帳及訂單追蹤。
highlights_en: Shoppers can still discover products via livestreams and short videos.
Reported features include in-app checkout and order tracking.
items.why: 東南亞商戶多了一個讓已有購物意圖的顧客回訪的入口。
items.why_en: Southeast Asian merchants gain a destination that shoppers can revisit with purchase intent.
items.next_step: 按市場檢查商品頁及促銷條款，分開量度內容導流和購物入口流量。
items.next_step_en: Check listings and offer terms by market, and track traffic from content and shopping entry points separately.
items.detail: 獨立App把購物功能集中在一個入口，並保留直播及短片。新加坡App Store由TikTok刊登的商品頁可核對應用及功能描述，四地開放情況則以TechCrunch的直接報道為據。TikTok當時未回覆該媒體的查詢，其他地區的開放時間仍待確認。商戶可先檢查不同入口的商品資料和優惠是否一致。
items.detail_en: The standalone app centres shopping while retaining video and livestream discovery. TikTok’s Singapore App Store listing documents the app and its features. TechCrunch reported the four markets and received no rollout comment from TikTok. Timing for other markets remains unconfirmed.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Future與InfoSum合作，擬把媒體受眾訊號接入WPP規劃工具
items.title_en: Future and InfoSum partner to bring publisher audience signals into WPP planning
items.summary: 兩家公司將連接Aperture與InfoSum，讓媒體規劃人員在現有流程使用出版商的第一方資料。
items.summary_en: The partners will connect Aperture and InfoSum so planners can use publisher first-party data in existing workflows.
highlights: WPP Media規劃人員將可在Open Intelligence使用相關訊號。
Future稱系統可配對品牌與出版商各自收集的資料。
highlights_en: WPP Media planners are set to get the signals in Open Intelligence.
Future says the integration supports matching brand and publisher first-party data.
items.why: 媒體團隊可評估出版商的內容互動訊號，能否補足品牌既有的受眾名單。
items.why_en: Publisher content engagement may fill gaps in an advertiser’s existing audience lists.
items.next_step: 請代理商列明可用市場、配對條件與受眾規模，再決定是否試投。
items.next_step_en: Ask the agency to confirm markets, matching requirements and audience sizes before a trial.
items.detail: Aperture利用Future旗下媒體的內容互動建立受眾分類。接入InfoSum後，規劃人員可按公告所述把這些分類用於媒體方案。品牌在比較這類資料時，宜把配對規模、實際可投放人數及投放後的增量分開記錄。公告未列出香港帳戶的開放日期，能否使用需按市場和代理商安排確認。
items.detail_en: Aperture groups audiences using engagement across Future’s media properties. The integration is intended to bring those groups into media planning. Track matching scale, reachable audience and campaign lift separately. The release gives no Hong Kong access date.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Amazon推出Shop Direct商戶入口，合資格店舖可提交商品目錄
items.title_en: Amazon opens Shop Direct workspace for eligible merchants’ product feeds
items.summary: 新工作台讓合資格商戶提交商品資料，商品有機會在Amazon搜尋及Alexa for Shopping出現。
items.summary_en: Eligible merchants can submit feeds for possible discovery in Amazon search and Alexa for Shopping.
highlights: 商戶可重用已為其他購物平台準備的商品目錄。
工作台列出已啟用的商品，商戶仍自行管理庫存、定價與履約。
highlights_en: Merchants can reuse catalogs prepared for other shopping destinations.
The workspace shows active items. Merchants still handle stock, pricing and fulfillment.
items.why: 品牌可把Amazon視為自家網店的另一個商品發現入口。
items.why_en: Amazon can become another product discovery entry point for a brand’s own store.
items.next_step: 先核對參與資格，以少量在售商品檢查價格、庫存與落地頁資料。
items.next_step_en: Check eligibility and validate prices, inventory and landing pages with a small assortment.
items.detail: Shop Direct原有的購物流程繼續運作，新推出的是商戶自助管理入口。一般導流會把顧客帶回商戶網站，合資格商品也可能經Amazon的代購工具完成購買。品牌可先挑選庫存穩定及資料齊備的商品接入，並在自己的分析工具分開觀察導流、結帳及訂單，以便評估這個入口。
items.detail_en: Shop Direct already existed. The new workspace lets merchants manage participation themselves. The standard flow sends shoppers to the merchant’s site, while some items qualify for Buy for Me. Track referrals, checkout and orders separately to assess the new entry point.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Stensul開放電郵成效回饋功能搶先體驗，審批仍由人員負責
items.title_en: Stensul opens early access to email performance feedback with human approval
items.summary: Stensul稱新功能把電郵表現連到內容版本，供團隊參考。Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next整合則已正式開放。
items.summary_en: Stensul says the new feature links email performance to content variants. Its Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next integration is generally available.
highlights: 電郵成效回饋屬搶先體驗。
行銷人員保留檢查、審批及決定發送內容的權限。
highlights_en: Email performance feedback is in early access.
Marketers retain review, approval and control over what is sent.
items.why: 電郵團隊可用內容層級資料找出值得再測的主旨、預覽文字或地區版本。
items.why_en: Content-level data can help email teams choose subject lines, preview text or local variants to test again.
items.next_step: 先選一項內容變數，設定對照組及成功指標，再比較下一次發送結果。
items.next_step_en: Pick one variable, set a control and agree on a success metric before the next send.
items.detail: Stensul把既有的內容審批流程延伸到發送後的表現分析。公司稱團隊可利用個人化或地區版本的表現找出值得研究的內容模式，再決定是否在下一封採用。不同受眾、促銷和發送時間都可能影響數字，因此觀察到的關聯需要再測試。這次正式開放的是Salesforce整合，電郵回饋功能仍處於搶先體驗。
items.detail_en: Stensul extends its approval workflow into post-send analysis. It says teams can use personalised or localised variants to identify patterns worth testing. Audience, offers and timing can all affect results, so observed associations need testing. General availability applies to the Salesforce integration; the feedback feature remains in early access.

items.title: Influ2讓B2B團隊按聯絡人意向訊號發掘新企業客戶
items.title_en: Influ2 adds contact-level intent to B2B account discovery
items.summary: 新功能Audienscope Discover以個別聯絡人訊號找出其所屬企業，供行銷及銷售團隊排序。
items.summary_en: Audienscope Discover uses signals from individual contacts to surface their companies for marketing and sales prioritisation.
highlights: 企業可來自現有CRM名單以外。
Influ2稱工具會隨新訊號持續調整企業排序。
highlights_en: The surfaced companies can be outside the existing CRM list.
Influ2 says rankings update as new signals appear.
items.why: B2B團隊可在擴充目標名單時，同時評估聯絡人角色和企業需求。
items.why_en: B2B teams can assess company fit and contact roles while expanding target lists.
items.next_step: 抽查新增企業是否符合目標客群，再由銷售核對聯絡人角色及訊號來源。
items.next_step_en: Sample new accounts and have sales check contact roles and signal sources.
items.detail: 以目標企業為單位的行銷通常先確定公司名單，再找相關聯絡人。Influ2這項功能把聯絡人的行為訊號用在前一步，協助發掘名單之外的企業。訊號可用於決定跟進順序，仍需確認企業是否適合、聯絡人有否參與採購，以及所用資料在目標市場的適用範圍。逐項抽查可避免只按總分分配銷售時間。
items.detail_en: Account-based marketing often starts with companies and then identifies relevant people. Influ2 uses individual signals earlier to find additional accounts. Teams still need to check company fit, buying roles and data coverage in the markets they intend to target. Sampling keeps the score from becoming the sole basis for sales follow-up.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: 騰訊雲公布私有部署方案，企業可分層接入AI代理
items.title_en: Tencent Cloud announces modular private deployment for enterprise AI agents
items.summary: 騰訊雲在深圳公布全棧智能套件和輕量部署方案，讓企業按需要選擇部署層級。
items.summary_en: Tencent Cloud announced a full-stack suite and a lighter deployment option in Shenzhen, with selectable deployment layers.
highlights: 套件涵蓋基礎設施、模型服務、代理運行環境及應用。
公司稱輕量方案可按完整私有雲或只用AI服務配置。
highlights_en: The suite covers infrastructure, model services, agent runtime and applications.
The lighter option has distinct configurations for full cloud and AI-only use.
items.why: 要讓代理讀取企業資料的行銷團隊，可與技術部門分開討論模型、資料及執行權限。
items.why_en: Marketing and IT teams can evaluate models, data access and execution rights separately.
items.next_step: 先列出一項客戶資料使用情境，請技術團隊核對所需部署、權限及日誌。
items.next_step_en: Choose one customer-data scenario and ask IT to verify deployment, permissions and logs.
items.detail: 騰訊雲把模型服務與代理運行環境分開列明。公告描述的運行環境包括隔離程式活動的沙箱、對外連線控制與身分憑證。完整私有雲和只部署AI服務有不同的起步配置，團隊應按現有系統與資料流向評估。選擇私有部署後，仍要逐項驗證代理能讀取哪些資料、呼叫哪些系統，以及誰可查看操作紀錄。
items.detail_en: Tencent Cloud separates model services from the runtime. The runtime includes an isolated sandbox, outbound connection controls and identity credentials. Full private cloud and AI-only setups have different starting configurations. Verify data access, callable systems and audit-log visibility for the intended workflow.

items.title: Orange逐步部署帳單客服代理，按代理設定回答及成本上限
items.title_en: Orange phases in billing support agents with per-agent scope and cost limits
items.summary: Algolia稱Orange已在部分市場使用Agent Studio，處理帳單及帳戶支援。
items.summary_en: Algolia says Orange has started using Agent Studio for billing and account support in some markets.
highlights: 每個代理可分別設定可回答的範圍與運作成本上限。
代理使用Orange自身的產品、規則和知識資料。
highlights_en: Each agent can have its own conversation boundaries and operating cost ceiling.
Agents use Orange’s product data, rules and knowledge content.
items.why: 客服團隊可按查詢類型設定邊界，逐步處理顧客購買後的問題。
items.why_en: Support teams can define boundaries by query type as they expand post-purchase automation.
items.next_step: 先選一類低風險帳單查詢，列明可引用資料、轉人工條件及每宗成本。
items.next_step_en: Start with one low-risk query type and document permitted sources, human escalation and cost per case.
items.detail: Orange本來已有使用Algolia的搜尋服務。公告這次交代的是把代理逐步放入帳單及帳戶查詢，並分開設定每個代理可處理的問題和開支。供應商稱已有部分市場啟用，後續擴展視結果而定。團隊評估這種做法時，可分開監察答案是否有資料支持、何時需要轉人工，以及每宗個案的處理成本。
items.detail_en: Orange already used Algolia search. The new work brings agents into billing and account queries with individual scope and spend controls. Algolia reports some markets live and further expansion dependent on results. Track grounded answers, escalations and case costs separately.

items.title: 香港精品生活展結合亞博展場與水上展示
items.title_en: Hong Kong premium lifestyle fair pairs convention halls with waterfront showcases
items.summary: Informa Markets在亞洲國際博覽館舉辦首屆精品生活展，並安排與大嶼山遊艇會聯動。
items.summary_en: Informa Markets staged the first premium lifestyle fair at AsiaWorld-Expo, with a crossover involving Lantau Yacht Club.
highlights: 主展期為11月4日至6日。
主辦方把室內展品與水上體驗納入同一活動設計。
highlights_en: The main exhibition ran November 4–6.
The organiser combined indoor displays and waterfront experiences in one event design.
items.why: 高端品牌可把商務洽談和產品體驗分配到不同場景，再用清楚的路線把兩者連起來。
items.why_en: Premium brands can assign meetings and hands-on experiences to different settings, then connect them with a clear visitor route.
items.next_step: 規劃跨場地活動時，分開記錄預約、實際到場及展後跟進。
items.next_step_en: Track reservations, attendance and post-event follow-up separately when planning a multi-venue event.
items.detail: 這次活動的主展場設於亞洲國際博覽館，主辦方亦安排展前節目和遊艇會聯動。跨場地的做法讓品牌可在展廳說明產品，再以實景展示補充體驗。評估同類活動時，宜分清不同場地承擔的工作，並核對交通、入場安排和客戶交接，才能判斷哪一環節值得在下一次沿用。展後可按買家類別整理跟進紀錄。
items.detail_en: AsiaWorld-Expo hosted the main exhibition, with pre-event programming and a yacht-club crossover. This format lets brands explain products indoors and add a real-world experience elsewhere. Evaluate each venue’s role, transport, admission and lead handoffs before repeating the format.After the event, organise follow-up by buyer type.

items.title: 尼泊爾旅遊局與TikTok以創作者和直播推廣旅遊
items.title_en: Nepal Tourism Board and TikTok use creators and livestreams for destination marketing
items.summary: 11月5日於加德滿都啟動的新一輪活動，透過專題標籤頁、創作者合作及景點直播展示旅遊體驗。
items.summary_en: The November 5 Kathmandu launch uses a hashtag hub, creator collaborations and destination livestreams to showcase travel experiences.
highlights: 活動計劃持續至2026年底。
本地創作者合作與國際旅遊創作者內容同步展開。
highlights_en: The campaign is scheduled to run through the end of 2026.
Local creator collaborations accompany content from international travel creators.
items.why: 目的地團隊可用同一主題聚合多地內容，同時保留創作者各自的觀眾與敘事角度。
items.why_en: Destination teams can gather content under one theme while keeping creators’ distinct voices and audiences.
items.next_step: 先分配景點與內容格式，再以標籤頁互動及實際查詢評估各段內容。
items.next_step_en: Allocate sites and formats first, then assess hub engagement and travel enquiries separately.
items.detail: 尼泊爾旅遊局6月已與TikTok在同一主題下舉辦短片工作坊。11月的發展是加德滿都啟動活動，以及透過專題標籤頁、創作者合作及景點直播安排內容發佈。Business 360的現場報道交代了活動安排，未有旅遊預訂或到訪數據。旅遊品牌可以分開記錄觀看、行程查詢和預訂，避免把不同階段的反應混算。
items.detail_en: The tourism board and TikTok held a June workshop under the same theme. November adds the Kathmandu launch and a distribution plan built around the hashtag hub, creator collaborations and livestreams. Business 360 reports event arrangements without booking or visitor results. Track views, enquiries and bookings separately.

items.title: WTA與Hello Kitty首度聯推官方商品，總決賽設現場銷售
items.title_en: WTA and Hello Kitty’s first official merchandise collection heads to Finals fan village
items.summary: 首批商品以網球場景呈現Hello Kitty，計劃在11月8日至15日印第安韋爾斯總決賽現場發售。
items.summary_en: The tennis-themed collection is planned for on-site sale at the November 8–15 Finals in Indian Wells.
highlights: 系列包括T恤、運動衫與毛絨公仔。
WTA稱完整系列亦將於Sanrio網站發售。
highlights_en: Items include T-shirts, sweatshirts and a collectible plush.
WTA says the full range will also be offered on Sanrio’s website.
items.why: 賽事與角色品牌可用限期現場銷售帶動試穿和展示，再由網店承接未到場的球迷。
items.why_en: A sports event and character brand can use a limited on-site window for display and fitting, with online sales for remote fans.
items.next_step: 規劃聯乘時分開訂定現場及網店庫存、補貨和履約規則。
items.next_step_en: Set separate venue and online rules for inventory, restocks and fulfilment.
items.detail: 這是WTA與Hello Kitty首個官方商品系列。WTA公布在總決賽球迷區銷售，並安排Sanrio網站提供系列商品。WTA另預計於2027年春季開設專屬球迷網店，現階段屬計劃。不同渠道的發售時間、庫存及配送範圍仍應以各店為準。品牌團隊可參考這種安排，在活動現場和網店分開設計商品陳列及購買流程。
items.detail_en: This is the first official WTA and Hello Kitty collection. WTA announced fan-village sales and a Sanrio online range. Its own fan shop is expected in spring 2027. Check sale timing, stock and delivery by channel. Teams can plan separate merchandising and checkout flows for the venue and website.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
